captain_shield.why: Most-owned (86%) and likely most-captained player. Per CLAUDE.md's locked rule, captain = season cum_pts leader (nailed premium, not a GK), and the backtest showed that fading the template captain cost points. The user owns him but GW5 captain was Gibbs-White with Haaland as VC. If Haaland hauls at ~150% EO, not captaining him costs about 1x his score in relative rank. DO NOT FADE unless a human override has fresh lineup info.
captain_shield.caveat: Tough fixture (LIV away, FDR 4) and model xPts 8.15 is lower than several defenders/Groß. That is the kind of matchup signal the holdout found did NOT beat cum_pts, so it should not override the lock. Check cum_pts leader status against live data; the cache has no cum_pts field.
